text:
Nora: Quick sync  we need a finalized send matrix for next Tue's launch newsletter. Goals: webinar signups, benchmark reads, and safe deliverability. Sheet here: https://docs.google.com/sheetsexample-launchmatrix :calendar:

Sam: Segments we talked about yesterday? I remember: early-access (4k), active-trial (28k), newsletter-only (100k), reheat (8k). Confirm sizes?

Ivy: Confirmed. early-access=4,120; active-trial=27,600; newsletter-only=101,200; reheat=7,950. Planning subject variants only for active-trial and a reheat survey CTA for reheat.

Ken: Deliverability note: our preferred provider is limiting sustained sends to ~10k/hr unless warmed. Suggest domain rotation + 6k/hr cap for newsletter-only. We'll do 3 chunks for newsletter-only across 36h. Also pre-send seed to 60 internal/test users across Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo.

Lina: Copy/creative: headline should surface the benchmark number (e.g., "3x inference cost reduction in real apps"). For early-access: stronger technical tone + CTA "Request early preview". For active-trial: show case study + CTA "Try this config". For newsletter-only: short TL;DR + link to benchmark. I'll prepare 3 templates and a plain-text version.

Nora: A/B and timing plan: active-trial gets Subject A/B + CTA A/B. early-access gets personalized salutation and roadmap ask. newsletter-only is control for deliverability but we'll sample 5% to a different subject variant to test engagement. Reheat flows go into a 5-day drip if they click.

Sam: Important: map clicks to inbound lead routing. If someone from active-trial clicks "Try this config" and visits /signup, tag as hot-lead and route to SDR queue 'launch-1'. If early-access clicks the roadmap CTA, add to research-feedback list. Need UTM scheme per-variant.

Ivy: I'll add UTM params: utm_campaign=launch_apr26, utm_medium=email, utm_source=newsletter, utm_content=variantA|variantB. Also adding header-level tracking (server-side open ping) to reduce client-side inflation.

Ken: Send CLI plan below. We'll run seed first, then ramp active-trial, then newsletter-only. Pause thresholds: complaint_rate >0.04% in any hour or bounce >1% pause that IP.

```
sendctl --env=prod --campaign=launch_apr26 --wave=seed --limit=6120 --note=preview
sendctl --env=prod --campaign=launch_apr26 --wave=active_trial --limit=6000 --ramp=10/30/60 --variants=A,B
sendctl --env=prod --campaign=launch_apr26 --wave=newsletter_chunk --limit=6000 --repeat=6 --rotate-domains
```

Lina: Accessibility checklist: alt text on images, include readable plain text, test dark-mode, and ensure CTAs are large/tappable for mobile. Also avoid spammy words in subject lines for newsletter-only.

Sam: On inbound routing: I'll add a Zapier + webhook route for the launch-1 queue (SDR). Route: click -> qualify by segment & activity -> webhook to internal lead intake -> assign. If >3 clicks in 24h mark as high intent.

Ivy: Suppressions to apply: global opt-outs, hard bounces, people who submitted support tickets in last 7 days, and anyone who opened but unsubscribed in the last 30d. Also exclude test domains and role accounts.

send-svc-bot: Planned waves created:
- seed_preview ts=1766512000 recipients=6120
- active_trial_wave ts=1766515600 recipients=27600 variants=A/B ramp=10/30/60
- newsletter_start ts=1766520000 recipients=101200 window=36h chunks=3
- reheat_drip_start ts=1766600000 recipients=7950 drip=5d

Nora: Great. Owners: Ivy will export tz-mapped CSV + add UTMs, Lina finalizes copy + plain-text by EOD, Ken will run domain rotation and supervise sends, Sam sets inbound routing + SDR mapping. We'll reconvene after seed wave for inbox checks and immediate learnings. :rocket:
